live_projection_readback.interpretation: This persisted summary came from a direct pass before execution-context capture was implemented. The live projection correctly leaves it unlinked; no scheduled Family pass was rerun for this readback.

static_checks.ruff_interpretation: The selected Ruff check reported five existing F401/F841 findings on unchanged lines in the checked files; it emitted no finding on the added code.

outcome.analysis_limit: The regression tests validate exact correlation and safe unlinked states. The live readback validates backward-compatible handling of an older direct-pass snapshot, not a new live scheduled match, correctness of the Family domain result, agent receipt, or burden reduction.
